rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something relating to administration, especially before nouns such as costs or work.

example.english: These are administrative tasks, so we do not need to handle them ourselves.
example.traditional: 呢啲係行政方面嘅工作，唔使我哋親自處理。
